Zelensky to Axios:

What did Trump get? That he will have more diesel? For whom? More Russian diesel for Americans? It shows weakness of the world.

NEW: The State Department’s inspector general is investigating U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle and the embassy she leads.

The probe comes after longtime Trump donor Eric Deters accused Guilfoyle of requesting $100,000 to pay her American Express bill before her 2025

Kalshi is investigating suspicious bets that correctly predicted Trump’s appointment of Katie Zacharia as White House press secretary.

Three bets totaling just $173 were placed shortly before the announcement and are expected to pay out about $9,600.

Zacharia was not considered
